requirements.title: A file storage unit is the storage, position, record-length, and file-size unit
requirements.definition: A file storage unit is the basic storage unit in a stream file or unformatted record file, the unit of file position for stream access, the unit of record length for unformatted files, and the unit of file size for all external files.

pending.file-storage-unit-basic-storage: Use future stream/unformatted fixtures only through standard I/O operations and never assert the processor's physical byte representation.
pending.file-storage-unit-stream-position-unit: Use POS= and INQUIRE(POS=) rules to identify positions in file storage units, asserting relative position properties only where registered.
pending.file-storage-unit-unformatted-record-len: Use INQUIRE(IOLENGTH=) or unformatted RECL rules to plan records; assert consistency of standard-reported units, not bytes.
pending.file-storage-unit-external-file-size-uni: Use a future INQUIRE(SIZE=) rule when registered; assert nonnegative/changed standard file-size units after known writes, not OS byte counts.

requirements.title: Values occupy integer file storage units with uniform unformatted scalar sizes
requirements.definition: Every value in a stream file or unformatted record file shall occupy an integer number of file storage units, and for unformatted stream or record files that number shall be the same for all scalar values of the same type and type parameters.

pending.values-occupy-integer-file-storage-units: Use INQUIRE(IOLENGTH=) on representative scalar/list items and require integer Fortran results only as reported by the standard inquiry; do not infer sub-file-storage-unit packing.
pending.unformatted-same-type-params-uniform-sto: Compare IOLENGTH= results for two distinct scalar values of the same type and kind/length parameters initialized to different nondefault values; expect equal reported lengths.

requirements.title: IOLENGTH= can determine storage units for a type and type parameters
requirements.definition: The number of file storage units required for an item of a given type and type parameters can be determined using the IOLENGTH= specifier of INQUIRE.

pending.iolength-determines-file-storage-units: Use INQUIRE(IOLENGTH=) on initialized items with distinct type parameters, assert the returned value is positive and stable for repeated inquiries of the same item, not any processor-specific numeric size.

requirements.title: Unformatted stream access shall not impose alignment restrictions on positive positions
requirements.definition: For unformatted stream access, the processor shall not have alignment restrictions that prevent a value of any type from being stored at any positive integer file position.

pending.unformatted-stream-no-alignment-restrict: Write a nondefault scalar value with unformatted stream POS= at an intentionally non-natural positive position such as 2 after establishing a file, then read the same position into a distinct sentinel and expect the value; do not assert gap contents.

requirements.title: FILE_STORAGE_SIZE gives the number of bits in a file storage unit
requirements.definition: The number of bits in a file storage unit is given by the FILE_STORAGE_SIZE constant from ISO_FORTRAN_ENV.

pending.file-storage-size-constant-bits: Use ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, read FILE_STORAGE_SIZE into an integer expression, and assert only that it is the standard inquiry value used for later size calculations; no fixed bit count is required by this facet.

requirements.title: An 8-bit octet file storage unit is recommended where practical
requirements.definition: It is recommended that the file storage unit be an 8-bit octet where this choice is practical.

pending.file-storage-unit-8-bit-octet-recommende: No conformance oracle may require FILE_STORAGE_SIZE == 8 because this is a recommendation conditioned on practicality, not a requirement; future tests may report but not fail on other values.
